title: Tool calls with invalid input remain stuck in `input-streaming` state
body:
### Description

**Problem:**
When an LLM calls a tool with invalid input, an `AI_TypeValidationError` is thrown. However, the tool call state is not properly updated - it remains in `input-streaming` instead of transitioning to an error state like `output-error`.

**Expected behavior:**
Tool calls with validation errors should transition to an appropriate error state (e.g., `output-error` or a new `input-error` state) to allow proper UI state management.

**Current behavior:**
- No error information is streamed to the UI
- No error information is included in the `onFinish` assistant message in `streamText`
- Tool call remains stuck in `input-streaming` state

**Impact:**
Cannot properly indicate tool call status (in progress/finished/error) to users in both:
- Real-time streaming with `useChat`
- Persisted messages from database

Currently using `ToolUIPart` to check tool call states in the UI. I want to show the user the progress of a tool call. If an input error occurs, the UI got stuck in `input-streaming` (in progress) as no error state is reported.

**Example of an `AI_TypeValidationError`:**

```
{
  toolInput: '{"bomUpdates": [{"operation":"update","id":"j0k1l2m3","changes":{"quantity":50}}]}',
  toolName: 'updateBom',
  [cause]: [Error [AI_TypeValidationError]: Type validation failed: Value: {"bomUpdates":[{"operation":"update","id":"j0k1l2m3","changes":{"quantity":50}}]}.
  Error message: [
    {
      "code": "invalid_type",
      "expected": "number",
      "received": "undefined",
      "path": [
        "bomUpdates",
        0,
        "changes",
        "stage"
      ],
      "message": "Required"
    }
  ]] {
    value: { bomUpdates: [Array] },
    [cause]: [Error [ZodError]: [
      {
        "code": "invalid_type",
        "expected": "number",
        "received": "undefined",
        "path": [
          "bomUpdates",
          0,
          "changes",
          "stage"
        ],
        "message": "Required"
      }
    ]] {
      issues: [ [Object] ],
      addIssue: [Function (anonymous)],
      addIssues: [Function (anonymous)]
    }
  }
}
``` 

### AI SDK Version

- ai: 5.0.0-beta.28
- @ai-sdk/react: 2.0.0-beta.28
- @ai-sdk/anthropic: 2.0.0-beta.9

linked_prs.title: fix (ai): handle invalid tool calls
linked_prs.body:
## Background

Sometimes models generate invalid tool calls. While `repairToolCall` helps in many situations, there are scenarios where it is difficult or not possible (e.g. dynamic tool calling or unknown tools). Invalid tool calls can cause UI tool parts to get stuck in the `input-streaming` state (see #7694 ).

## Summary

This PR will enable automatic tool call repair via additional steps.

* `NoSuchToolError`, `ToolCallRepairError`, and `InvalidToolInputError` are no longer thrown when parsing tool calls
* instead, a dynamic tool call part with `invalid: true` and `error: cause` and a corresponding dynamic tool error part is are created (dynamic parts are used because the types or tool names might will not fit expected structures)
* modified ui message tool `output-error` state to support rawInput that is not typed

This PR introduces some tech debt to avoid breaking changes as much as possible. See future work below.

## Manual Verification

- [x] test generate text repair example (console) 
- [x] test UI end to end with mocked failure scenario and follow-up message

## Tasks

- [x] change parsing tool calls to generate invalid dynamic tool call parts
- [x] generate text: auto insert tool error parts for invalid tool calls
- [x] generate text example
- [x] generate text test
- [x] stream text auto insert
- [x] stream text test
- [x] ui message chunk definition
- [x] ui message chunk conversion in streamText
- [x] ui message parts definition
- [x] ui message part parsing
- [x] converting back to model messages
- [x] ui test example
- [x] changeset

## Future Work

The implementation was made with backwards compatibility in mind (no breaking changes) and could be cleaner. This should get sorted out in AI SDK 6.

- AI SDK 6: separate invalid and error properties from `DynamicToolCall` into new `InvalidToolCall` type (breaking change)
- AI SDK 6: replace error output part injection with invalid tool call parts
- AI SDK 6: handle tool input errors better in ui messages

## Related Issues

Fixes #7694

Yes.  
This issue involves tool invocation and error handling in an LLM-based agent system, specifically the failure to update tool call states after an input validation error. It directly relates to agent-specific components: tool invocation, error state management, and UI feedback for agent workflows.
